We'll have a short how-to session on a Saturday morning, and if it goes well we'll keep it running through the spring.

Recap from tonight's PTA meeting. The people who couldn't make it are in the loop. We talked about a bunch of things, I'll go to them one at a time. The fall fundraiser did better than we expected. The board voted to put most of it toward new library books, the rest towards the playground-shade structure. The teachers asked us for more volunteers at lunch duty, especially on Fridays, because they're stretched really thin. There is a sign-up sheet going around, they love even one shift a month. The carpool line is still a mess in the mornings. The principal is going to try a staggered drop-off by grade starting after the holiday, watch for an email about that. We decided to bring back the family movie night in the gym probably once a month in the winter, we need someone to take the lead on organizing snacks. A few parents raised concerns about how much homework the fourth graders are getting, and the principal agreed to bring it up at the next staff meeting and report back to us.
